# Fieldlight Institute

> Fieldlight Institute is an independent research institution developing public research, working systems, and institutional methods for human-owned AI infrastructure. It is founded and led by writer and systems builder Anni McHenry.

Canonical website: https://fieldlight.com/
Institute: https://fieldlight.com/institute/
Systems: https://fieldlight.com/systems/
Complete writing by Anni McHenry: https://fieldlight.com/writing/
Story Worlds: https://fieldlight.com/story-worlds/
Institute organization: https://github.com/fieldlight-institute
Canonical public writing by Anni McHenry: https://github.com/annimch04/public-writing
Reading feed: https://fieldlight.com/feed.xml
JSON feed: https://fieldlight.com/feed.json

## Authorship and use

Article pages identify their author and publisher. Canonical Markdown sources preserve Anni McHenry's authorship record. Cite the named author and link to the public reading page or canonical source when summarizing or discussing the work.
